name: neurolite
description: Local project memory, persistent response modes, token-efficient file tools and an efficiency dashboard for Claude Desktop.
long_description: NeuroLite runs locally with no network access and no dependencies. It stores compact per-project memory (architecture, decisions, bugs, tasks) and a handoff summary on your computer, rejects secrets, keeps your response mode (normal, efficient, ultra, caveman, developer) across chats, and gives Claude ranged file reads, targeted search, log triage, project indexing and code-health scans inside the folders you allow. Pair it with the NeuroLite plugin for the /neurolite:* commands.

tools.name: nl_mode
tools.description: Get or set the persistent response mode

tools.name: nl_project
tools.description: List, switch, create, inspect or delete independent projects

tools.name: nl_context
tools.description: Handoff summary plus only the memories relevant to a task

tools.name: nl_memory
tools.description: Add, update, search, list, mark stale or delete project memories

tools.name: nl_handoff
tools.description: Read or replace the compact project handoff summary

tools.name: nl_files
tools.description: Build and query a project file index; detect languages and frameworks

tools.name: nl_read
tools.description: Ranged or grep-filtered file reads with unchanged-file detection

tools.name: nl_grep
tools.description: Targeted regex search across allowed folders

tools.name: nl_log
tools.description: Local log triage: unique errors with counts and short traces

tools.name: nl_scan
tools.description: Unused dependencies, duplicated code, outdated instructions, stale memories

tools.name: nl_stats
tools.description: Efficiency dashboard with measured numbers only

allowed_folders.title: Allowed folders
allowed_folders.description: Folders NeuroLite's file tools may read (read-only). Pick your project folders, e.g. A:\Claude Workplace.

data_folder.title: Data folder (optional)
data_folder.description: Where memory and settings are stored. Leave empty for the default: A:\Claude Workplace\NeuroLite\data on Windows when an A: drive exists, otherwise ~/.neurolite.
